'''Isryn's Veil''' was the third quadrant of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. The area was considered safe during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:IV">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space_poi|Isryn's Veil|Dantooine system}}</ref> It was frequented by pilots of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Midnite Forsberg]] made regular runs through Isryn's Veil.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|290|Forsberg, Midnite}}</ref>
